claims.source_statement: PCA-guided raw-feature granular centres are encoded with a tensor product of single-qubit RY(pi*c_l).
claims.transfer_boundary: Fixed product feature map; trainable quantum feature maps are explicitly future work on p18. Abstract feature-learning language is not evidence of joint parameter training.

claims.source_statement: Similarity is squared state overlap, estimated by a Swap Test.
claims.transfer_boundary: Its ideal kernel equals product_l cos^2(pi*(c_l-c_l_prime)/2); known tensor-product identity, not new theory or a task-utility result.

claims.source_statement: Cohesion is mean similarity to nearest neighbours; bottom10percent are temporarily excluded, then reassigned after core clustering.
claims.transfer_boundary: Not permanent point deletion. The sparse graph/average-linkage clustering decision unit differs from native 40-query signed-value attention.

claims.source_statement: Reported comparisons include KM/DP/GBSC/GBCT and QM/QKKM/QCKM, plus no-GB/2means/no-cohesion ablations.
claims.transfer_boundary: The reported tables/ablations do not isolate the same PCA/cohesion/graph pipeline with the exact analytic product kernel. This is a limitation of reported evidence; author code is uninspected.

claims.source_statement: Noisy16 mean ACC reported .964 vs .884 and NMI .944 vs .872 with versus without cohesion.
claims.transfer_boundary: Source rounded averages, not our reproduced experiment. Several rows tie; improved source averages do not establish quantum-specific NLP benefit.

claims.source_statement: Average ball counts704.125 to319.6; approximate kernel-pair counts247456 to51040 underpin an about80percent reduction.
claims.transfer_boundary: Not a measured native40*T attention speedup or a per-dataset reduction guarantee. Native already uses fixed40 queries, not an N-by-N sample Gram.

claims.source_statement: CPU Qiskit simulation; overall n^(3/2)*d+n*d^2 complexity discussion, and runtime/representation ablations are reported.
claims.transfer_boundary: Asymptotic assumptions include small dimension and compressed count; no direct native TRAIN runtime theorem, hardware advantage or independent task confirmation.

claims.source_statement: Parameter table supplies target cluster counts and some baseline settings; future work includes hardware and trainable maps.
claims.transfer_boundary: Known cluster count is a common clustering setup, not automatically leakage. No independent multi-seed/tuning protocol was established by this source reading.
